title: 第11章 晕了五天一睁眼遇到个大阴阳师-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    周围都是一片惨白的颜色，她正前方有个正在散发出幽幽蓝光的，很高科技的橄榄形舱室。

    艰难的吞咽了几下，秦夙试着问：“这……这又是什么地方？我还在离颂的精神图景里吗？”

    然而，等了许久，都没等到美人向导的回答。

    秦夙只好告诉自己，得冷静。

    至少，现在这个空间里，并没有什么黑麒麟，也看不到刚才那诡异的带铃铛的绣球了。

    说不定她已经开始疏导了？毕竟，进到这里之后，她能具象化看到自己身上，缓慢的正在向外散发红色的雾气。

    精神力触手是红色的，那她的精神力肯定也是红色的，说不定她已经误打误撞的开始疏导了呢？

    说不定，再在这里待一会儿，她的精神力，就能对离颂和他的精神体起到安抚作用，能减轻他的精神污染。

    只要离颂恢复理智，她就有救了。

    离颂不会对她的处境视而不见，毕竟，她的身体，可是他妹妹萧岑的。

    好，这些分析都很靠谱，所以没什么可怕的。

    秦夙慢慢往那个不足两米高度的，橄榄型的舱室走去。

    距离还剩一两步时，她突然听到舱室里传出一声痛苦的嘶吼，“啊！！！”

    紧跟着，竟然看到一个半透明状，类似魂体的东西，像是要冲出舱室那般，从透明的舱盖凸显出来！

    然而那疑似魂体的东西，却又随着那声痛呼，被一缕缕漆黑的精神力牢牢拽住，强行拉回了舱室里！

    可，可发出叫声的，分明是个小孩吧？！

    这魂体看着却是个成年男人了，这是怎么回事？

    秦夙赶紧冲过去，趴在透明舱盖往里一看！

    果然，里头躺着的，就是个七八岁的小男孩！

    他紧闭着双眼，脸色惨白，穿着一身纯黑色的实验服，被几根束带牢牢绑在舱内的床架上，身体正痛苦的左右扭曲！

    这是在做实验吧？

    拿活人做实验？还是小孩？也太残忍了吧！

    秦夙身上溢出更多红色的气雾，颜色比先前更浓，还混杂进了丝丝缕缕的金光！

    她似乎还闻到了这种气雾之中，淡淡的桔子香味。

    然而不等她再去细品。

    那些红和金的颜色，就都被舱里这个小孩吸收掉了！

    秦夙愣愣看着这一幕，难道……这小孩是个哨兵？

    哎呀不管了，先把人弄出来再说！

    她扒着舱体想去找开启舱盖的开关。

    围着这个橄榄型的东西绕了好几圈，最后发现侧面一个操作台上放着个文件夹。

    她跑过去低头一看。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The surroundings were pale, and right in front of her was a high-tech olive-shaped cabin that was emitting a faint blue light.

After swallowing hard for a few times, Qin Su tried to ask: "This... what kind of place is this? Am I still in Li Song's spiritual picture?"

However, after waiting for a long time, there was no answer from the beautiful guide.

Qin Su had no choice but to tell himself to calm down.

“At least, there is no black unicorn in this space now, nor can we see the weird hydrangea with bells just now.

Maybe she has already started counseling?After all, after entering here, she could physically see the red mist slowly emitting from her body.

Since her spiritual tentacles are red, her spiritual power must also be red. Maybe she has started channeling by mistake?

Maybe, if she stays here for a while, her mental power will be able to soothe Li Song and his mental body, and reduce his mental pollution.

As long as Li Song regains her senses, she will be saved.

Li Song will not turn a blind eye to her situation. After all, her body belongs to his sister Xiao Cen.

​ ​ Okay, these analyzes are very reliable, so there is nothing to be afraid of.

Qin Su slowly walked towards the olive-shaped cabin that was less than two meters high.

When she was still one or two steps away, she suddenly heard a painful roar coming from the cabin, "Ah!!!"

Immediately afterwards, I saw a translucent, soul-like thing protruding from the transparent hatch cover as if it was about to rush out of the cabin!

However, with that cry of pain, the thing that seemed to be a soul was firmly grabbed by wisps of dark spiritual power and forcibly pulled back into the cabin!

But, the one who made the cry is obviously a child, right?!

This soul looks like an adult man. What's going on?

Qin Su rushed over, leaned on the transparent hatch cover and looked in!

Sure enough, the person lying inside was a seven or eight-year-old boy!

He had his eyes closed tightly and his face was pale. He was wearing a pure black lab coat and was tightly tied to the bed frame in the cabin by several straps. His body was twisting left and right in pain!

This is an experiment, right?

Do experiments on living people?Or a child?It’s too cruel!

More red mist overflowed from Qin Su's body, the color was thicker than before, and it was also mixed with wisps of golden light!

She seemed to smell the faint orange fragrance in the mist.

But don’t wait for her to taste it carefully.

Those red and gold colors were all absorbed by the child in the cabin!

Qin Su stared at this scene blankly, could it be that... this child is a sentinel?

No matter, let’s get the people out first!

She picked up the cabin body and tried to find the switch to open the hatch cover.

After walking around this olive-shaped thing several times, I finally found a folder on a console on the side.

She ran over and looked down.

title_en: Chapter 11 After being unconscious for five days, I met a great Onmyoji when I opened my eyes - "What to do if you are targeted by N S-class sentries at the same time"
